title: Provolone Philly Cheesesteaks with Golden Onions
summary: Half-frozen rib eye is shaved, seared hard until cooked through, tossed with golden onions and torn provolone, topped with more slices to melt and flipped into soft sub rolls.
equipment: large cast-iron or heavy frying pan, 30 cm

ingredients.item: medium onions, halved and thinly sliced
soft sub rolls, about 20 cm (about 320 g)

steps.title: Freeze
steps.text: Firm the steak in the freezer for 45-60 minutes.

steps.title: Cook the onions
steps.text: Cook slowly until soft and golden.

steps.title: Sear
steps.text: Sear the beef in a very hot pan until browned and cooked through.

steps.title: Melt
steps.text: Stir in onions and torn provolone, then melt slices on top.

steps.title: Fill
steps.text: Flip each pile into a roll and serve hot.

tips: Partly freezing the steak lets you slice it thin.
Get the pan very hot for browning rather than stewing.
Sharp provolone gives more flavour than mild.
storage: Best eaten hot. Refrigerate the filling within 1 hour for up to 3 days and reheat until piping hot. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
